title: Detailed tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='42' ry='5' fill='#1b3a2e'/>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='17' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#5c5c5c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='11' fill='#8a8a8a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#b5b5b5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='4' fill='#d9d9d9'/>
  <!-- rear treads -->
  <g stroke='#4a4a4a' stroke-width='2'>
    <line x1='72' y1='53' x2='72' y2='57'/>
    <line x1='72' y1='83' x2='72' y2='87'/>
    <line x1='55' y1='70' x2='59' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='85' y1='70' x2='89' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='60' y1='58' x2='63' y2='61'/>
    <line x1='81' y1='79' x2='84' y2='82'/>
    <line x1='84' y1='58' x2='81' y2='61'/>
    <line x1='63' y1='79' x2='60' y2='82'/>
  </g>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='10' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#5c5c5c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='5.5' fill='#8a8a8a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='2' fill='#d9d9d9'/>
  <!-- body / fender block -->
  <rect x='18' y='56' width='60' height='20' rx='4' fill='#c9302c'/>
  <rect x='18' y='56' width='60' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e05a4f'/>
  <!-- engine hood -->
  <rect x='18' y='44' width='30' height='16' rx='3' fill='#c9302c'/>
  <rect x='18' y='44' width='30' height='5' rx='2' fill='#e05a4f'/>
  <!-- hood grille lines -->
  <g stroke='#8f1f1c' stroke-width='2'>
    <line x1='22' y1='48' x2='22' y2='58'/>
    <line x1='28' y1='48' x2='28' y2='58'/>
    <line x1='34' y1='48' x2='34' y2='58'/>
    <line x1='40' y1='48' x2='40' y2='58'/>
  </g>
  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#7a7f85'/>
  <rect x='23' y='33' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#a8adb3'/>
  <!-- steering wheel + seat -->
  <line x1='56' y1='56' x2='56' y2='40' stroke='#4a4e54' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#d9dde2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='60' y='50' width='12' height='6' rx='2' fill='#2f6f3e'/>
  <rect x='63' y='44' width='8' height='8' rx='2' fill='#3d8a50'/>
  <!-- cabin roof -->
  <rect x='48' y='30' width='28' height='5' rx='2' fill='#e9b44c'/>
  <rect x='50' y='32' width='3' height='24' fill='#4a4e54'/>
  <rect x='72' y='32' width='3' height='24' fill='#4a4e54'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <!-- chimney smoke puff -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='4' fill='#d9dde2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='22' r='5' fill='#e8ecf0' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
